text: いってい　じかんが　たつか　ボールを　ぜんぶ　なげたら　おわりです！

structure.jp: いってい　じかんが　たつか
structure.en: either a set amount of time passes, or

structure.jp: ボールを　ぜんぶ　なげたら
structure.en: when you have thrown all the Balls

patterns.name: 〜か (or)
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb offers a choice: this or the next thing. たつか = '(time) passes, or'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら means 'when' or 'if' this has happened. なげたら = 'when you've thrown them'.
